strategy: Create or reuse an immutable percent-off coupon from the current cart's charged tuition products. Deterministic ID includes policy, rate and product IDs. No fixed catalog allowlist or manual coupon-ID environment map.
deposits: Excluded from automatic aid. Deposit-only checkout creates no aid coupon.
customer_entered_promotion_codes: Available without financial aid, including 100%; follow Stripe's configured coupon restrictions with no added product restriction.
provider_permission: Coupons Write is needed for the runtime credential. The existing test key was approved and verified with Coupons Write; live scope must be reviewed at release.
retained: Existing coupons are not modified or deleted.
